name: AlphaCode 2
one_liner: Pairs Gemini Pro code generation with execution filtering, behavioral clustering, and a learned scoring model to rank competitive programming solutions.

loop.proposes: A family of fine-tuned Gemini Pro models samples up to one million diverse C++ candidate programs per problem.
loop.judged_by: Sandboxed execution prunes about 95% of samples that fail the public example tests or do not compile, then clusters survivors on synthetic inputs.
loop.steers: A second Gemini scoring model ranks the top cluster representatives; there is no repair step.

headline_result: Solved 43% of Codeforces Division 1+2 problems and ranked at the 85th percentile of human competitors.
caveat: High inference compute budget per problem; correctness remains bounded by test coverage rather than formal proof.
beyond_harness_note: Execution-based pruning and dynamic input-output clustering filter a million-candidate population down to 10 submissions.
algorithmic_authority: Sandboxed C++ execution filter and behavioral clustering engine

verification.notes: Checked against AlphaCode Team, Google DeepMind Technical Report 2023.
